investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Verdoxa Learning (online learning); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.126.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster verdox-prod-europe (GKE); Database: postgres server course-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-course-to-db; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
